verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is the French tax administration's official online service portal (accounts, payments, declarations, forms). Self-hosting the 'core product' is a category error for a sovereign government tax service, since users cannot run the national tax authority's systems themselves. Nothing in the evidence suggests any self-hostable distribution, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
